group.ja: 温度制御・分子動力学

summary.ja: 粒子対に散逸力と確率力を加えて温度を制御する。標準的な対称な対力は対の全運動量を保存する。
summary.en: Control temperature using dissipative and random pair forces. Standard symmetric pair forces conserve the pair’s total momentum.

caution.ja: 流体的な運動量輸送を扱う場合の候補。摩擦・雑音の対応、距離重み、有限刻みの影響を検証する。
caution.en: Relevant when momentum transport matters. Verify matched friction/noise, radial weights and finite-step effects.

next_deliverable.en: Add a dedicated formulation and integration recipe, followed by explicit-input distribution and time-correlation checks with stated degrees of freedom, random seeds and step sizes.
